official_global_time_definition: Epoch milliseconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00 GMT; US Pacific conversion for local time (official attachment pp.2-3).
camera_synchronization_statement: Local US-101 metadata p.1 describes eight synchronized cameras; it does not supply movie frame/PTS to Global_Time anchors.
next_required: Obtain independent raw reference, timestamp/frame origin and rate evidence, then verify multiple physical anchors and any camera transitions; no arbitrary offset or nearest-frame matching.

existing_diagnostic_anchor.meaning: Identity diagnostic clock anchor only; not video PTS synchronization

separate_clock_quantities.Global_Time: Epoch milliseconds; documentary definition and reused Task5 ranges
separate_clock_quantities.Frame_ID: Dataset internal frame index; no verified raw-video-index relation for these cameras

minimum_future_evidence: Raw camera7/8 for each authorized period with verified source/license
ffprobe stream metadata and individual frame PTS after acquisition approval
Multiple reliable anchors near beginning/middle/end for each camera and period
Check offset/rate/drift/dropped or repeated frames/inter-camera consistency
Processed overlays optional for localization only, not independent identity truth
Provider must clarify temporal coverage beyond nominal filenames where epoch support extends
method_limit: Coifman & Li2024 verifies no temporal offset before spatial alignment; it does not supply the missing PTS mapping
